transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm just having some trouble keeping track of things lately. Just... forgetting little things that I usually handle fine. 

Like, um, returning phone calls, or remembering to turn in a registration form. Or just stopping for an errand on the way home. It's... yeah, that's what finally made me ask for help.
How long have you been experiencing these memory problems?
Um... I guess maybe for the last year or so? Like... 15 months, maybe. I started an evening certificate program around then, and... it just got noticeably harder to manage things after that.
Are these memory problems causing you significant distress or interfering with your daily life or relationships?

Um... I mean, I'm still getting by, mostly. But... yeah, I guess it's a little stressful. I've missed a few small follow-ups at work, and some deadlines for my classes. It's not a disaster yet, but... I just worry it's going to make me look bad. I was hoping to try for an Office Manager position eventually, and... I don't know, this isn't helping.
Have you noticed any difficulties with concentration or making decisions?

Um... concentration, I guess. It's... hard to stay on track. Like, if I'm at work or in class, and the phone rings, or people are just... talking nearby. Even just, I don't know, remembering something I need to do at home. It just... pulls me away from what I'm doing.
Have you been feeling sad, empty, or depressed lately?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I'm just a little stressed about keeping up, but... I don't feel sad or anything like that. Just... normal, mostly.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I get a little worried about the deadlines sometimes, like I said, but... I don't feel anxious overall. Just... regular, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your personality over the past year?
Um... no. Not really. I'm pretty much the same.
Have you experienced any physical symptoms, such as headaches or fatigue, over the past year?
Um... no. Not really. Just... tired sometimes, I guess, but nothing out of the ordinary. No headaches or anything.
Have you experienced any particularly stressful or traumatic events in the last year or so?
Um... no, not really. Nothing major like that. Just... normal life stuff, I suppose.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to learn new things?
Not that I've noticed. I mean... my work is pretty routine, so there isn't really much new stuff I have to learn anyway. But no, I think it's about the same.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to perform daily tasks that require planning or organization?

Um... I suppose maybe a little. I usually keep up at work just fine, but... I started taking some evening classes recently. And... I don't know, lately my desk, my class folders, email reminders... they all just sort of turn into piles. I guess I end up wasting time just trying to figure out what I’m supposed to do first.
Do you have difficulty finding the right words when speaking or writing?
No, I don't think so. I usually... I can usually say what I mean well enough.
Have you been avoiding social situations or activities that you normally enjoy?
No... not really. I still do the things I usually do, I guess. Nothing's really changed there.
Have you noticed any decline in your ability to understand or follow instructions?
Um... no, not really. I understand things fine when people tell me what to do. That hasn't changed or anything.
Do you find that you get mentally exhausted more easily than you used to?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I get tired after work sometimes, but just the normal amount, I guess. Nothing unusual.
Do you have trouble remembering things you've learned recently, like what you studied in your evening classes?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I remember most of what I learn. It's just normal stuff. I haven't noticed any big problems with that.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions or taken any new medications in the last year or so?
Um... no, I haven't. Nothing new like that. And no new medications, either.
Have you experienced any changes in your physical health that could be affecting your cognitive abilities?
No... my health is fine. I haven't noticed any physical changes or anything like that.
Has something specific happened in the last year or so that might have triggered these memory and concentration problems for you?

Um... not exactly. I mean, nothing bad happened. Just... I guess it's been noticeably harder to keep track of things since I started taking classes. I'm doing this evening certificate program... I started it about 15 months ago, I think. It's just been harder to manage since then.
Have you received any feedback from your employer or colleagues about your work performance changing since you started experiencing these memory and concentration problems?

Um... no one has formally said anything to me. I'm still getting by. But... I guess I have dropped the ball on a few small follow-ups at work recently. And some deadlines for my classes. 

I just... I worry people are noticing. I'm hoping to move into an Office Manager role eventually, and... I just really don't want this to affect my reputation.
